channel.description: Recent content in News on CMJM Lab

item.title: NSTC AI Research Project Funded
item.description: We are excited to announce that our AI research project has been funded by the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC). This grant will support our continued work in developing artificial intelligence applications for biomedical research, including AI-driven multiomics integration and tool development for precision medicine.

item.title: CMJM Lab Website Launched
item.description: Welcome to the new CMJM Lab website! Our site provides comprehensive information about our research in computational multidata analysis in medicine, team members, publications, and open-source software tools. Stay tuned for updates on our latest research and opportunities to join the team.

item.title: New Publication in Blood Cancer Discovery
item.description: We are pleased to announce our new publication in Blood Cancer Discovery. This work continues our efforts to advance understanding of hematological malignancies through computational approaches, contributing novel insights into blood cancer biology and potential therapeutic strategies.

item.title: New Publication in Science Advances on Ultraconserved Elements in Cancer
item.description: Our latest research has been published in Science Advances. This collaborative work investigates the mutational landscape and functional effects of noncoding ultraconserved elements in human cancers, providing new insights into how these highly conserved genomic regions contribute to cancer biology. The study represents a large-scale, multi-institutional effort advancing our understanding of non-coding genome function in oncology.

item.title: Now Accepting Applications: Master's Program in Smart Medicine and Health Informatics
item.description: The Master’s Program in Smart Medicine and Health Informatics at National Taiwan University is now accepting applications. This international program offers advanced studies in bioinformatics, computational medicine, and precision health. We welcome motivated students from diverse backgrounds to join our lab and contribute to cutting-edge research at the intersection of AI and medicine.
